seo.title: With Jeremy — Websites & better leads for northside Brisbane businesses
seo.description: Local web and digital help for tradies, salons and small businesses in Brendale, Albany Creek and Brisbane's northside. Senior-level work at a flat, fair price.

hero.sub: Local web and digital help for tradies, salons and small businesses in Brendale, Albany Creek and the northside.

about.heading: Building for Brisbane since the iPhone landed in 2008.
about.body: I've spent my career making apps and websites for boutique agencies and big enterprise. Now I want to put that experience to work for the businesses around me — so local tradies, dog groomers and dentists get a web presence fit for 2026 and, most importantly, better leads.

audience.heading: Made for local businesses
audience.suburbsLabel: Based in Brendale, working with businesses across

deal.heading: Senior-level work at a fair, flat price.

pillars.title: Just me, start to finish.
pillars.body: You deal directly with an experienced developer and designer. No account managers, no junior handoffs, no $8k retainers padding the invoice.

pillars.title: Built while you work.
pillars.body: Recorded video walkthroughs and batched feedback, so there's no phone tag during your busy day — and I get focused, uninterrupted time on your build.

pillars.title: Fast, lean and yours.
pillars.body: Clean, lightweight sites instead of bloated page builders. You own everything, and video guides mean simple edits never need a developer.

deal.trade: I won't pick up the phone at 10am. In return, you get better design and sharper technical work at a fair, predictable price.

process.heading: From first chat to more leads.

steps.title: Understand your business
steps.body: Who your customers are, what a great job looks like, and what a good lead is worth to you.

steps.title: Review what you've got
steps.body: Your current site, Google Business Profile, socials and reviews — what's working and what's costing you.

steps.title: Find your edge
steps.body: Together we pin down why people should choose you over the business down the road.

steps.title: Put it to work
steps.body: Your edge on the web, with the tools you need to grow: lead forms, bookings or online sales.

steps.title: Hand it over
steps.body: Video walkthroughs and full ownership. It's yours — no hostage fees.

work.heading: Recent projects
work.nextBody: Want to be next? Founding client spots are open.

items.title: Branding & logos

items.title: Website design & build
items.body: Fast, modern sites built on WordPress blocks or static architecture, designed to turn visitors into enquiries.

items.title: Google Business Profile & local search
items.body: Get found on the map when locals search for what you do nearby.

pricing.heading: Flat price. No surprises.
pricing.body: I'm taking on a small number of founding clients at this rate while I build up my local portfolio. You get a fixed quote before anything starts.

items.a: We'll have a proper kickoff chat to start. After that, work runs on short video walkthroughs and written feedback you can reply to whenever suits — no juggling calls between jobs.

contact.heading: Tell me about your business.
contact.body: A few quick details and I'll come back to you with a plan and a flat price.
